design_philosophy: A serious medical/clinical internal tool. Must feel trustworthy, calm, efficient, and FAST to use. High information density without clutter. No playful illustrations or dark mode.

rules: Use Work Sans for all headings, Work Sans 500 or 600 for card titles.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, form inputs, and tabular data.
Apply tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) to H1 and H2.
Use tabular numbers (`tabular-nums`) for ages, dates, and billing amounts.
CRITICAL: Never use Inter or Roboto.
Use desktop-first layouts (Target: 5 PCs on LAN).
Grid gaps should be tight (`gap-4` or `gap-6`) for density.
Cards should have minimal padding (`p-4` or `p-5`) to maximize data visibility.
Use a persistent left sidebar (`w-64`) for navigation.
Card styling: Flat background (`bg-white`), 1px subtle border (`border-gray-200`), NO SHADOWS (keeps it clean/flat).
Optical alignment: align text to the left for data readability.

components_strategy.forms: Use highly structured Shadcn form components. Place labels explicitly above inputs. Inputs should have subtle 1px borders and slight focus rings (`focus:ring-teal-600/20 focus:border-teal-600`).
components_strategy.tables: Dense Shadcn tables. Use sticky headers for long lists. Implement alternating row colors (`even:bg-gray-50`) if it improves scanability.
components_strategy.badges: Status workflow chips must be pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), using the specified status colors (e.g., waiting, in-consultation).
components_strategy.ai_assist_panel: Design as a floating side-drawer or fixed right panel. Use a subtle gradient or distinct background (like `#F8FAFC`) to separate it from clinical notes.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA in Teal (`#0F766E`), secondary in outline style with gray text. Avoid large border-radius; keep it sharp (`rounded-md`).
components_strategy.navigation: Role-based visibility. Highlight active path with the Primary Teal color and a left border accent (`border-l-4`).

icons_and_assets.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a sophisticated, lightweight clinical feel. Avoid heavy/filled icons.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle background color changes. `hover:bg-gray-50` on table rows. `hover:border-teal-600` on inputs.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Keep animations minimal and fast (`duration-150 ease-in-out`). Do not delay workflow.

requirements: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes.

image_urls.description: Bright white clinic room, modern minimalist design. Use as the background for the login page with a heavy white overlay (`bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm`) to keep the login form prominent.
Use Lucide 'Leaf' or 'Cross' icon combined with typography for the logo instead of external images, to keep the UI lightweight.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI is strictly desktop-first and optimized for horizontal space.
Avoid generic purple or dark mode styling completely.
Build Shadcn components using raw Tailwind overriding where necessary to remove shadows and implement 1px borders.
Implement the 'AI assist panel' with 3 distinct action buttons (Summarize, Draft, Instructions) prominently visible for the Doctor role.
Include a printable receipt view for the PRO/Billing role (bilingual EN+Telugu layout simulation).
